{{Youmay|a [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like [[Rock (disambiguation)]]|a [[Chalcedony (freighter)|starship named ''Chalcedony'']]}}
[[File:AlsakanTessent-Gamer9.png|thumb|200px|The [[Alsakan Tessent]], a statue made of chalcedony]]
{{Quote|Clear in places, kind of milky in others, with these bands of colors running through it.|[[Barzur Antilles]]|<ref name="RFT">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref>}}
'''Chalcedony''' was a type of [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like rock that had either a [[Milk/Legends|milky]] translucence,<ref name="RFT" /> or, in some cases, a darker [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="Core">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Statues would be sculpted in chunks of chalcedony: the [[Alsakan Tessent|tessent]] idols of [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] were made of it,<ref name="RFT" /> and so were effigies of [[Borz'Mat'oh]] and [[Fillorean]] at the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]].<ref name="Core" /> On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], chalcedony was strongly associated with the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], who used it as a signet of office.<ref name="ANH">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' (novel)]]</ref> At the time of the [[Great Galactic War]], the ruling lord of the House was referred to as the "heir to the chalcedony star."<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Additionally, the [[Royal Chalcedony Shield]], a medal awarded by the [[High Council of Alderaan]] to worthy off-worlders, was also made of chalcedony.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref>
